newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ capital goods price index down 0.1 pct Sept qtr.
newsitem.headline: NZ capital goods price index down 0.1 pct Sept qtr.

text.p: The capital goods price index fell 0.1 percent from the June to September quarters, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.
That followed a 0.2 percent fall in the June quarter and no change in the March quarter.
The capital goods price index rose 0.7 percent from the September 1995 quarter to the September 1996 quarter.

The non-residential buildings price index rose 0.2 percent in the September quarter and is now 2.8 percent higher than a year ago. The most significant decrease in the quarter was the transport equipment prince index, which fell 0.5 percent.
